name: ReplaceText
label: Replace Text
description: Replaces all occurrences of a specified subtext with another text. It can also be used with regular expressions.

fields.name: SearchPattern
fields.label: Search Pattern
fields.description: The subtext or regular expression pattern to replace.

fields.name: UseRegex
fields.label: Use Regular Expressions
fields.description: If true, treats 'Search Pattern' as a regular expression.

fields.name: IgnoreCase
fields.label: Ignore Case
fields.description: If true, performs a case-insensitive search.

fields.name: ActivateEscapeSequences
fields.label: Activate Escape Sequences
fields.description: If true, interprets escape sequences in the replacement text.
